test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 15 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All teachers are professionals.

All professionals are doctors.

**Conclusions:**

(I): Some doctors are teachers.

(II): All teachers are doctors.
solution:
**Statements:**

All teachers are professionals.

All professionals are doctors.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7291c246fc338a4f466e6b0fb950cae54dcc0e1edd7fc4461c18a166cb29af3d.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some doctors are teachers. - Follow (Because, all teachers are professionals and all professionals are doctors, which means some doctors are teachers.)

(II) All teachers are doctors. - Follow (Because, all teachers are professionals and all professionals are doctors, which means all teachers are doctors.)

Thus, both conclusions (I) and (II) follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 1**".
